$comment: Shipped-bundle budgets in KiB -- see scripts/bundle-budget-gate.mjs.
Unlike quality-baseline.json these are NOT auto-recorded: a bundle may
legitimately grow when a feature lands, so raising a number must be a
deliberate line in a diff with a reason, not a regenerated file.
Seeded from the 2026-09-03 build with roughly 5% headroom.

note: The installable offline PWA (ADR 0090). Its service worker precaches
every byte counted in `total`, so this is what a device downloads on
install, once, over whatever connection it has.
83% of that total is one file: the client-core Wasm sync engine at
~12.5 MiB. It dominates `total` and `largestAsset` while contributing
nothing to `javascriptGzip`, which is why both are budgeted -- a JS
regression would be invisible inside a 15 MiB total.
2026-09-10: javascript 2500->2750 and javascriptGzip 725->790 because
browser-local IAM precaches passkey/WebAuthn and the local issuer. The
PWA still precaches every JS byte; measured 2616/748 KiB plus ~5% headroom.
2026-09-13: css 130->139 because the phone layout and touch contract
landed (DESIGN.md Touch, verify:mobile): the 44px floor gained a
width-based fallback, every field gained a 16px floor so iOS stops
zooming and never zooming back, and the statusline, tab bar, front door
and scrolling strips gained phone and landscape arrangements. Measured
132.1 KiB plus ~5% headroom. Uncompressed is what is budgeted; on the
wire the whole of it gzips to 26 KiB.
2026-09-15: javascript 2750->2800 and javascriptGzip 790->810 because
browser-native SIOPv2 (ADR 0116) adds a lazy /identity/siop ceremony
chunk (~19 KiB) plus @opensesame/siop-v2 ES256 mint helpers. Measured
2764/794 KiB after the SIOP build; budgets keep ~1–2% headroom.

2026-09-16: javascript 2800->3450, javascriptGzip 810->980, total 15500->16700 because ADR 0123 spending Wallet lands Pages /wallet panels, conserved ledger/leases/consent, and wallet-* packages in the offline PWA. Measured CI 3252/926/15901 KiB; budgets keep ~5% headroom.

2026-09-17: javascript 3450->3770 and javascriptGzip 980->1070 because ADR 0125 ambient SSO adds a lazy @azure/msal-browser 5.22 chunk (only loaded for a selected Entra connection) plus the ambient-auth controller/transaction/admission modules. Measured 3584/1016 KiB; budgets keep ~5% headroom. MSAL is not on the default personal startup path.
